description: OLE-ROWLIFE on a read/write copy: a server keyset optimistic Recordset on Items with Fields ID retained, Clone moved independently (ID of each); the original deletes row 2 (Status, ID of the deleted row, MoveNext, ID, MovePrevious, ID); the clone moves across the deleted row; Resync(adAffectAll, adResyncAllValues), RecordCount, ID; Requery, RecordCount, retained ID; the clone after the original's Requery; then the original Closes and the retained Field, the clone's State and ID are read. Asks row identity and validity of retained field wrappers, deleted-row access and clone behaviour.
retentionNote: Designed r-oledb-odbc probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
